charge_port.notes: Automoblog: NACS-compatible port on all 2025 trims except the GT, which keeps CCS1. Electrek: GT excluded from the NACS port move (Korea-built).
NHTSA/Kia TSB (search excerpt): certain 2025-2026MY EV6 have CCS1 ports; with the press statements that only the GT keeps CCS, this is the GT. No Kia US GT page naming the port was found.

supercharger_access.notes: CCS1 Kia vehicles use Tesla Superchargers with a Kia-approved adapter.

adapters_included.notes: US: Kia sells the Kia-approved NACS-to-CCS1 adapter through dealers (reported $249, Electrek Jan 2025) to owners outside the free offer. 2025 EV6 is outside the free offer (2024-25 EV9 and 2024 EV6 only).

heat_pump.notes: KBB 2025 EV6: heat pump standard on AWD models (GT is AWD-only). US source.
